title: LEGO themes and what they are about

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia
source.method: enwiki: each Lego theme article intro (Lego Star Wars, Technic, Duplo, Ninjago, City, Friends, Harry Potter, Minecraft, Architecture, Castle, Space, Mindstorms, Speed Champions, Bionicle, Elves, Batman, Ideas, Legends of Chima, Nexo Knights, Monkie Kid, Super Mario) checked against the Lego parent article

about.pick: What is the LEGO {label} theme about?

rows.label: Star Wars
rows.about: Jedi, X-wings and a galaxy far, far away

rows.label: Technic
rows.about: Gears, axles and pins for building working machines

rows.label: Duplo
rows.about: Extra-large bricks made for toddlers

rows.label: Ninjago
rows.about: Martial-arts heroes who master spinjitzu

rows.label: City
rows.about: Police, fire crews, airports and construction sites

rows.label: Friends
rows.about: Mini-doll girls living in the town of Heartlake

rows.label: Harry Potter
rows.about: Hogwarts, wands and a boy wizard

rows.label: Minecraft
rows.about: Blocky sandbox video game worlds in brick form

rows.label: Architecture
rows.about: Micro-scale models of famous landmarks and skylines

rows.label: Castle
rows.about: Knights, kings, dragons and medieval fortresses

rows.label: Space
rows.about: Astronauts, rockets and alien encounters

rows.label: Mindstorms
rows.about: Programmable robots with a computer brick

rows.label: Speed Champions
rows.about: Small versions of real sports and race cars

rows.label: Bionicle
rows.about: Masked robotic action-figure heroes in a mythic fantasy saga

rows.label: Elves
rows.about: Teen heroine Emily Jones and the magical land of Elvendale

rows.label: Batman
rows.about: Gotham's Dark Knight, his Batmobile and his rogues

rows.label: Ideas
rows.about: Sets that begin as designs submitted by fans

rows.label: Legends of Chima
rows.about: Warring tribes of animals such as lions, eagles and crocodiles

rows.label: Nexo Knights
rows.about: Medieval-style heroes blending holograms and mechs

rows.label: Monkie Kid
rows.about: A modern retelling of Journey to the West and the Monkey King

rows.label: Super Mario
rows.about: Nintendo plumber's platform-game worlds, with an interactive figure
